summary.name: QDuo
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu-bar style popup that appears at the text cursor when you select text, letting you run your own actions (AI prompts, search, speech, text transforms, Shortcuts, shell scripts) and put results back.
use_cases: translate selected text in any app
polish or rewrite a sentence with an AI prompt
search the web for highlighted words
extract text from a screenshot region
run a shell script on selected text
summary.what_it_does: QDuo shows a popup (a capsule bar above the selection or a ring around the cursor) when you select text in native apps, browsers, or Electron apps. Each action can be an AI prompt that streams its answer, a URL opened with the selection, a speech output, one of 22 local text transforms, a Shortcut, or a shell script. Results can replace the selection, be inserted after it, or copied to the clipboard, per action. A hotkey lets you drag a box over the screen and get recognised text in the same popup. Settings live in a JSON config file at ~/.config/qduo/config.json, with API keys stored in the Keychain.
notable: Popup appears at the cursor with capsule or ring layouts, including Liquid Glass style
Supports DeepSeek, OpenAI, Doubao, Qwen, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with per-action model choice
22 local text transforms plus Shortcuts and shell script hooks
Config is a single JSON file suitable for dotfiles; API keys kept in Keychain
caveats: Page does not state pricing; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware and open source on GitHub
AI actions require a model provider or endpoint of your own
